全场女性角色数 is implemented as current living effective-gender participants, including a female skill owner if this skill is granted. Dead characters are off the active table. No same-current-version primary FAQ found spelling out every general-library/hidden-general gender combination; native CharacterState.Gender is reused.

After the fixed draw, only currently unowned candidate skills are selectable; already owning all three still draws3 and finishes without duplicate grants. The current page/client have no same-current-version explicit all-owned FAQ.

Once real draw movements are issued, their exact original child cursor drains once through source loss; a living owner still completes the grant. Owner death stops a new personal skill grant. Actual focused command/replay checks cover original LoseHp death followed by source loss or owner death, and original Damage death followed by source loss; broader combinations remain unverified.
